import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] secondLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        long[] a = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = Long.parseLong(secondLine[i]);
        }

        int half_point = n / 2;

        List<Long> part_a = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Long> part_b = new ArrayList<>();

        generateAllSums(0, 0, a, m, half_point, part_a);
        generateAllSumsRest(half_point, 0, a, m, n, part_b);

        // Remove duplicates and sort
        TreeSet<Long> setA = new TreeSet<>(part_a);
        List<Long> sorted_unique_part_a = new ArrayList<>(setA);

        long max_total = 0;

        for (long val : part_b) {
            long target = m - val;
            int index = lowerBound(sorted_unique_part_a, target);
            if (index > 0) {
                long candidate_sum = sorted_unique_part_a.get(index - 1) + val;
                if (candidate_sum > max_total) {
                    max_total = candidate_sum;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(max_total);
    }

    static void generateAllSums(int i, long current_sum, long[] a, int m, int half_point, List<Long> part_a) {
        if (i == half_point) {
            part_a.add(current_sum);
        } else {
            generateAllSums(i + 1, (current_sum + a[i]) % m, a, m, half_point, part_a);
            generateAllSums(i + 1, current_sum, a, m, half_point, part_a);
        }
    }

    static void generateAllSumsRest(int i, long current_sum, long[] a, int m, int n, List<Long> part_b) {
        if (i == n) {
            part_b.add(current_sum);
        } else {
            generateAllSumsRest(i + 1, (current_sum + a[i]) % m, a, m, n, part_b);
            generateAllSumsRest(i + 1, current_sum, a, m, n, part_b);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) < key) {
                low = mid + 1;
            } else {
                high = mid;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
